deficiencies.description: The rewrite converts the lecturer's pointing words ('the tumor is here' and 'This is the outer surface of the uterus') into a spatial relationship ('The tumour lies next to the outer surface of the uterus') that the text does not state or verify.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: You can see that the tumor is here. This is the outer surface of the uterus.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: The tumour lies next to the outer surface of the uterus

considerations.sourcePassage: So you can see again that this is actually circumspect and very separate from the surrounding stroma and the surrounding tissue.
considerations.reason: The lecturer said 'circumspect', which is a slip or malapropism for 'circumscribed', the standard pathological descriptor for well-demarcated benign tumours. Correcting this to 'circumscribed' is scientifically correct and allowed.
